translation.name: Habo nalolene bi gahenge lo winigo ogo

book.name: MADIU
book.title: Madiu Madiuhanda Bi Mana Debene gili binigo ogo

content: Yasu ibuni mo heya henego ogo
Horo Sandengi egerebagiore muna biyagola Magadala wali Meribi Meri mendebi libu Yasu egeanda horo hayagoha hondo pene.
Hondo pialu hebira dindi dumbirumbi timbuniore bialu Anduane Homogonaga dahuliyali mbira dahuliya andaga howa dalipe halu ege to̱le̱ panga payini biago dugu a̱i̱ howa panga biagoriani berene.
Dahuliyali biagonaga dengui wá taraorehe hari daba ale ibunaga aga biago demborerebi pele taraore hene.
Ogonibi heago hondowa mamage ho hayaruni ti gi timbuni howa mogo lalu homene aleore wini.
Ani bu wiagola dahuliyali biagome wali biago labohondo lalu, Gi nahalibu. Libu Yasu ira bangani ba para hayago tai berabigoni i̱ manda bido.
Ibu oali nahe ibuni bulebero layadagua abale heyalu piya. Ibu wiyago dege de hondole ibidaba.

Libugua abale puwa ibunaga talima piaga biaruhondo au lalibu. Yasu ibuni mo heya halu áyu ogoni ibu bamba halu Galili pole piyago ogoriani tí de hondoleberami lalibu. O langerogoni embeda nahalibu, lene.
Ani lamiyagola libu gi tago tago gerai pialu howa nde turu holene to̱lai ho yalu ibunaga talima piaga biaru lamule pene.
Libu pialu hebira abaleore Yasu libu lola howa lalu, Mo palia holene libu heba haabo helo, lene. Ani layagola libugua Yasu heagoria ha para howa ibunaga geni yu huribale buwa ibu mini yaraga hene.
Ani biyagola Yasuhanda libuhondo lalu, Gi nahalibu. I̱ amu Galilini koria tigua hondolebirago libugua i̱ hamene biaru Galili pudaba lole pudaba, lene.
Mamage hayarume lama piyagola hale howa binigo ogo
Wali biago labo harigani pialu hebi tagi agali egeanda mamage hayarume Yarusalemeha abale dai buwa biyago damenego bibahendeore loma binigo mo miaga haguane hearu lamiai hene.
Lamiai hayagola loma binigo mo miaga haguane biarubi agali ala hene miniwi hearubi mandagi mogo buwa bi lo mbiraore howa tigua ami agali biaruhondo muni dewa mini.
Mialu howa lalu, Tígua agua lalimu. Mbiraga ina palia hondo hemaha ibunaga talima piaga biarume ibuwa ibu tingini mo page biyiya, lalimu.
Gabumane haru haga kagome bi ogoni hale hayagua iname ibuhondo, O laragoni heneneore lara, laramagola tí agali tigabiore ka lalu ogoninaga mini dege dindi ho holene henge nawulebira, lene.

Ani layagola ami agali mamage haga biarume muni biago mo yalu puwa tigua bilimu layadagua bini. Ani binigo ndelene ogoni. Yu wali agalime loyogo lenego wali agali kamarume áyubi bi ogoni dege loyogo lalu kagoni.
Yasu ibunaga talima piaga biaru hearia ha pani henego ogo
Yasunaga talima piaga beriali biaru Yasuhanda pilimu layagoha Galilinaga bare hombene wiagoha iraga halu pene.
Puwa tigua Yasu hondowa ibu mini yaraga halu howa marume mini kira kira wuwa hene.
Yasuhanda ti heagoria ha para howa lalu, Ngode Datagaliwabehanda harihabi dindihabi hongo holene bibahende i̱hondo ngiai hayagoni.
Ogonigo tí dindi bibahendeha wali agali bu karuha puwa ti i̱naga talima ibaga helo helalimu. Ani buwa Aba mininibi Igini mininibi Ngode Datagaliwabe Dinini mininibi howa ti baboraya bia halimu.
Ani buwa i̱na tí langirugo manda biai helo bayuwa lawai halimu. Tígua ani bialu kamigola hamaro bulene horo helo i̱ tí heba haabo holebero, lene.
